messages:
maria-marketing: Quick sync  we need final changelog URL + canonical docs link for the launch post. APAC canary then global after 2h, right?

sam-eng: Yes. Changelog: https://docs.redwood.inference/release/2026-03-23-changelog (ready). Docs canonical: https://docs.redwood.inference/launch/2026-03-optimize. Canary starts 11:00 PDT, promote 13:00 PDT if metrics look good.

maria-marketing: Please paste the exact YAML for the blog/playbook and a one-line benchmark for the hero (latency@256 + cost delta).

sam-eng: YAML to include:
```
rollout:
  canary:
    start: "2026-03-23T11:00:00-07:00"
    regions: ["apac"]
    initial_pct: 5
    step_pct: 10
    promote_after: 2h
  global_promote: "2026-03-23T13:00:00-07:00"
```
Also use the docs link above for model profiles and quant notes.

ellie-product: Suggested hero: "95th pctl latency @256 tokens (A100, int8): 42ms; ~3.1x cost reduction vs fp16." I'll draft a short bench paragraph and drop it in.

nate-growth: I'll schedule the webinar ~90m after global promote (14:30 PDT) and wire registration/embed.

jon-sre: Webhook routing ready. On changelog publish deploy-bot will POST to /support/lead-route and tag "enterprise" when company_size>200. Example payload added to support playbook.

maria-marketing: Final checklist: changelog (sam)  docs (sam)  bench (ellie)  webhook (jon)  webinar (nate)  speakers list (maria by EOD). deploy-bot: publish hook?

deploy-bot: Scheduled publish hook set for 2026-03-23T10:00:00-07:00. If assets change after 09:30 PDT ping #release-war-room.

maria-marketing: Thanks team 680 i'll post final draft here for quick review before publish.
